# WXYJ Content System

Canonical name: 威熏邑境自媒体内容生成系统
English name: WXYJ Content System
Skill ID: wxyj-content-system
Version: 2.1.1

Purpose:
A Codex Skill for product-led whisky content operations across Xiaohongshu,
Douyin, and WeChat Channels. It creates titles, captions, tags, comments,
AIGC prompts, storyboards, QA reports, and standardized content-run folders.

Primary documentation:
- README.md
- docs/getting-started.md
- docs/content-contract.md
- docs/output-structure.md
- docs/naming-convention.md
- docs/compliance.md
- SKILL.md

Important boundaries:
- Real product facts must be checked against labels and files.
- AIGC supports expression and must not impersonate real evidence.
- Generated media is incomplete without matching publish copy and QA.

This file is a concise agent-reading aid.
